Starfield's newest story DLC and its biggest free update yet are both dropping on April 7! The Terran Armada has risen, marching an army of advanced robots across the Settled Systems to “unite” humanity by force. Fight back, uncover new tech, adventure with a new companion, and claim powerful new rewards as you defend the galaxy from hostile takeover. The new Free Lanes update will be free to all players and brings major upgrades to space travel, customization, New Game+, outposts, and much more. Experience both Terran Armada and Free Lanes on April 7.

Successful, charming, and calculated, Tae-Young was assigned to create MiNA – a virtual K-Pop idol inspired by The Trickster. Little did he know he would find his life turned upside down by his creation, who proved to be as bloodthirsty as she was iconic.

author: Xbox
description:
Take the fight to the Dragon Lords now:
https://www.xbox.com/games/store/dragonkin-blood-scales-edition/9NMPCKGRJZ0C/0017

In this action-ARPG, play solo, in local co-op (2-player) or any combination of up to 4 players online, build your city, and your legacy as you tear through the Dragonkin, unlock new abilities, and find near gear. 

Or if you prefer, play solo and offline, with no need to be permanently online, but still adding your new characters to the city.

Train your wyrmling, find a gameplay style that suits you by powering up skills on the Ancestral Grid, and clear out the Dragon Hordes. 

Dragonkin: The Banished is out now for owners of the Blood Scale edition, and will unlock for everyone on March 19th.
